title: Today's Worship
body: "How Great Thou Art" — take a moment today to sit with this hymn and let it prepare your heart for Sunday.

title: Today's Worship
body: "It Is Well With My Soul" — whatever this week has held, let this be your song today.

title: A Word Before Sunday
body: We can't wait to worship alongside you this Sunday. Come as you are — there is room for you here.

title: A Prayer Before the Weekend
body: Lord, as this week closes, thank You for Your faithfulness in it. Prepare our hearts for Sunday, and rest our bodies tonight. Amen.

title: This Sunday
body: Join us for worship this Sunday morning — check the church schedule for service times and this week's ministries.

title: A Gentle Reminder
body: "Each one must give as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver." (2 Corinthians 9:7) If you're able, consider giving toward this Sunday's offering.

title: Serve This Sunday
body: Our church runs on the quiet faithfulness of volunteers. If you have an hour to give this Sunday, reach out to a ministry leader — every hand matters.

title: Verse for the Weekend
body: "Not neglecting to meet together, as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another." (Hebrews 10:25) See you Sunday.
